Islam, Politics and Society

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Islam, Politics and Society at Radboud studies Islamic traditions, sacred texts and the lives of Muslim communities in historical and contemporary contexts. Students combine religious studies with social and political inquiry.

The adopted curriculum is shown below as a supported outline while course entry requirements are being checked. UCR alternatives are withheld until that check is complete. The reviewed UCR courses offer related study in philosophy, politics, social research and cultural heritage, but a final comparability decision has not been approved.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Full bachelor without Arabic: requirements check pending

The adopted curriculum lists 180 EC: 120 EC of required major study, two whole 15 EC modules and 30 EC of open minor study. The course entry basis for Islamic Thought and a prior-knowledge condition in the public-domain course still need confirmation. This is a supported outline, not a certified complete pathway. Introductory instruction and the academic Dutch assessment carry no credits.

Official programme source ↗
Verified partial curriculum — incomplete degree pathway

Only the verified components listed below are shown. They do not constitute a complete degree programme.

Religie en publiek domein in historisch perspectief

The current catalogue requires prior knowledge of Buddhism and Hinduism. How that condition is met in this pathway still needs confirmation.


Islamitische Theologie tussen theorie en praktijk
5 EC

Onderzoeksproject (PPO2)
10 EC
Year-long methods and research project building on first-year methods and skills.


Module Religie en Zorg
15 EC
Selected 15 EC restricted module: religious and moral meanings of care, religious texts and rituals in healthcare, and psychology of religion. Other whole-module choices are permitted.


Module Wereldbeelden, Natuur en Klimaat
15 EC
Selected 15 EC restricted module: religion, humans and nature; integral ecology; and climate change in the global South. Other whole-module choices are permitted.


Vrije minorruimte
30 EC
30 EC of open bachelor study, with no overlap. Advance approval applies to relevant outside-faculty choices and internships.


PPO3: Geesteswetenschappen in Praktijk
5 EC

Eindwerkstuk
10 EC
10 EC of independent research with academic skills prior knowledge, compulsory workshop attendance, approval of the research question and individual supervision.
